capabilities: Rollover unchecked todos from the previous daily note into today's note
Trigger rollover automatically when a new daily note is created
Run manual rollover and undo commands from the command palette
Optionally delete rolled-over todos from the previous note and skip empty ones
Customize which checkbox markers count as done, including Unicode and emoji markers
extras: Warns that automatic rollover can conflict with Templater and recommends manual triggering in that case; commands are destructive with only a single 2-minute undo, and regex-based matching has known inconsistencies with spaces and rapid triggers.
problem: Obsidian daily notes leave unfinished tasks stranded in old notes, so incomplete todos are easy to lose track of day to day.

relations.evidence: triggered automatically when a new daily note is created via the internal Daily notes plugin
useful for users of custom status markers like the Obsidian Tasks plugin

requires.name: Daily notes or Periodic Notes (with Daily Notes setting on)

summary: Task rollover plugin that copies unchecked checkbox items from the previous daily note into today's note, automatically or via command.
